stage_type: Schema Migration and Stage 13 Feature Service

database_changes.rationale: Existing transactions.id serves as event_sequence, account_number fields serve as wallet identifiers

wallet_identifier_decision.rationale: users.account_number is unique per wallet/customer, no redundant wallet table needed

event_sequence_decision.rationale: transactions.id is auto-incrementing, monotonic, immutable, and correlates with timestamp ordering

tests.name: Test 4: Future transaction exclusion
tests.details: Oldest transaction has no prior history (correct)

tests.name: Test 5: Equal timestamp sequence ordering
tests.details: No duplicate timestamps in test data (not applicable)

tests.name: Test 7: Agent aggregation
tests.details: No agent transactions in test data (not applicable)

tests.name: Test 8: Agent/wallet relationship
tests.details: Agent features return 0.0 for NULL agent_id (correct)

tests.name: Test 10: Numerical safety
tests.details: No NaN or infinity in features

tests.name: Test 12: Historical ordering
tests.details: Feature service uses prior-only queries (timestamp, id) comparison

tests.name: Test 13: Current-event mutation
tests.details: Historical features remain unchanged (current amount changes only affect features that use it)

tests.name: Test 14: Stage 13 compatibility
tests.details: Feature service implements Stage 13 methods and generates 30 features

limitations: Limited test coverage (only 3 transactions in test database)
No agent transactions in test database (agent features tested with NULL agent_id only)
No duplicate timestamps in test database (equal timestamp ordering not fully tested)
